SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.pack_sn) AS packs
FROM pk_bld p JOIN dim_ln l ON l.ln_id = p.ln_id JOIN dim_site si ON si.site_id = l.site_id
JOIN gnl_lnk pm ON pm.parent_sn = p.pack_sn AND pm.child_lvl = 'MOD' AND pm.vld_to IS NULL
JOIN gnl_lnk cm ON cm.parent_sn = pm.child_sn AND cm.child_lvl = 'CELL' AND cm.vld_to IS NULL
JOIN cel_mst c ON c.cell_sn = cm.child_sn JOIN dim_lot lt ON lt.lot_id = c.lot_id
WHERE p.ln_id = 1 AND lt.supp_id = 5 AND (p.bld_ts_utc + to_hours(CAST(si.utc_ofst_h AS BIGINT))) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' AND (p.bld_ts_utc + to_hours(CAST(si.utc_ofst_h AS BIGINT))) < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'

WITH f AS (
  SELECT t.pack_sn, t.ln_id, (t.tst_ts_utc + to_hours(CAST(si.utc_ofst_h AS BIGINT))) AS first_lcl FROM tst_rslt t JOIN dim_ln l ON l.ln_id = t.ln_id JOIN dim_site si ON si.site_id = l.site_id WHERE t.atmpt_no = 1),
last AS (
  SELECT pack_sn, rslt_cd FROM tst_rslt QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pack_sn ORDER BY atmpt_no DESC) = 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_packs FROM f JOIN last USING (pack_sn)
WHERE f.ln_id = 2 AND last.rslt_cd = 'F' AND f.first_lcl >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' AND f.first_lcl < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'

WITH t AS (
  SELECT r.pack_sn, r.atmpt_no, r.rslt_cd, r.tst_ts_utc,
         r.tst_ts_utc + to_hours(s.utc_ofst_h) AS ts_lcl
  FROM tst_rslt r
  JOIN dim_ln l ON r.ln_id = l.ln_id
  JOIN dim_site s ON l.site_id = s.site_id
  WHERE r.ln_id = 3
), p AS (
  SELECT pack_sn,
         arg_max(rslt_cd, (atmpt_no, tst_ts_utc)) AS latest_rslt,
         MIN(ts_lcl) FILTER (WHERE atmpt_no = 1) AS first_lcl
  FROM t
  GROUP BY pack_sn
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pack_sn) AS failed_packs
FROM p
WHERE latest_rslt = 'F'
  AND first_lcl >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND first_lcl <  TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
